video_caption: The video opens with a title screen on a solid purple background. White, centered text reads: "Incision and Drainage" (Incision and Drainage), "Axillary Abscess in a Young" (Axillary Abscess in a Young), "Girl" (Girl). This title introduces the medical procedure that will be shown in the video, indicating a surgical incision and drainage of an abscess located in the armpit area of a young female patient.

In a sterile medical setting, two gloved hands perform a procedure. One hand, wearing a light-colored surgical glove, firmly holds a small, reddish, fleshy object, possibly a digit, which is partially wrapped in a white pad or gauze. The other gloved hand, also wearing a light-colored surgical glove, holds a clear syringe with a dark substance inside. The syringe's plunger is being pressed, and the needle appears to be inserted into the object, suggesting an injection or aspiration. The entire area is covered by a blue surgical drape, highlighting the sterile environment.

In this video segment, a person wearing blue surgical scrubs and light yellow gloves is performing a medical procedure. Initially, they are injecting a substance from a syringe into a small, raised, pale pinkish-brown lesion on a patch of skin, which is draped in blue surgical material. A small amount of blood is visible around the lesion. After the injection, the person removes the syringe and then uses a small, pointed metallic instrument to gently probe or manipulate the lesion. During this, a yellowish fluid and some blood ooze from the site. Finally, the metallic instrument is set aside, and the person uses a white cotton swab to dab the area, cleaning away the fluid and blood, with the lesion still visible on the draped skin. The overall setting appears to be a medical environment, such as a clinic or operating room.

The video segment opens with a close-up shot of a small, skin-colored, fleshy object, likely a finger or toe, resting on a blue surgical drape, partially covered by a white gauze. A person wearing yellow surgical gloves enters the frame, using their left hand to hold a white gauze against the object for stabilization. Their right hand, also gloved, uses a small, sharp surgical instrument to carefully manipulate the object. As they work, a thin, white-to-yellowish string-like structure is meticulously pulled out from the fleshy object, becoming increasingly visible as the procedure continues. The setting appears to be a sterile medical environment.

In a medical setting, a person wearing sterile beige gloves is seen performing a procedure on a light brown, fleshy object resting on a blue surgical drape. At the beginning, the gloved hands use tweezers to gently probe an area on the object, which appears to have some redness, possibly indicating a wound or incision. A piece of white gauze is also visible. The tweezers are momentarily lifted. Shortly after, one gloved hand holds a piece of white, gauze-like material, while the other hand, wielding tweezers, carefully extracts a small, irregular, reddish-pink piece of tissue from the main object. This extracted tissue is then placed on the white gauze. Following this, the tweezers are used to apply pressure around an opening on the light brown object, causing a yellowish-white substance, likely pus, to be expressed and absorbed by the white gauze. The person continues to meticulously squeeze and clean the area, repeating the process of expressing the substance, indicating the drainage of an abscess or similar infected lesion. The audio reinforces this, with a voice commenting on "so much pus" and asking "Feeling any better?", suggesting the procedure is bringing relief to a patient (though only the surgical field is visible).

In this video segment, a person wearing light yellow surgical gloves meticulously performs a medical procedure on a digit, likely a finger or thumb, which rests on a blue sterile drape. The digit is partially wrapped in white gauze, some of which is stained red with blood. The person's left hand holds the gauze and stabilizes the digit, while their right hand uses a pair of fine-tipped surgical scissors or forceps to carefully probe and manipulate a small, reddish opening or incision on the digit's surface. The movements are precise and focused, highlighting the delicate nature of the medical intervention. The background remains a consistent blue, characteristic of a sterile medical environment.

A person wearing light-colored surgical gloves holds surgical forceps in their right hand, clamping a small, reddish-brown piece of tissue, possibly a cyst or growth, while another gloved hand stabilizes a white gauze pad to the left. Several other white gauze pads, some stained with blood, are visible on a blue surgical drape. A voice states, "This is which is really. I'm going to send it for pathology. I think you had a cyst in there, honey that got infected," as the tissue is then placed on the drape next to the bloody gauze pads.

In a medical setting, a person wearing light-colored surgical gloves is meticulously trimming a reddish, fibrous biological tissue. The gloved left hand holds the tissue, partially wrapped in a white gauze, while the gloved right hand operates surgical scissors to make precise cuts. Another, smaller piece of reddish-brown tissue rests on a blue surgical drape to the right, partially on a white material, with some red stains (likely blood) visible on the drape around it. The individual is focused on the task, suggesting a detailed preparation or processing step of the tissue.

In the video segment, two individuals wearing light-colored medical gloves are performing a medical procedure. One gloved hand holds a piece of white gauze, which has some blood on it, while the other hand uses a surgical instrument, possibly scissors or forceps, to meticulously manipulate tissue around a small incision on the patient's skin. The patient's body is covered by a blue surgical drape, with only the immediate area of the procedure visible, and there is noticeable blood around the incision, indicating an active surgical site. The setting appears to be a sterile medical environment, likely an operating room or a procedure room.
